create_ChannelNorm2D_with_affine: create a ChannelNorm2D layer with affine parameters for normalizing tensor channels in a neural network
create_ChannelNorm2D_without_affine: create a ChannelNorm2D layer without affine parameters by setting affine to False
run_ChannelNorm2D_forward: run the ChannelNorm2D forward pass on a 4D tensor to normalize across channel dimension
review_ChannelNorm2D_epsilon: review the ChannelNorm2D epsilon parameter to adjust divide-by-zero protection for numerical stability
test_ChannelNorm2D_validation: test the ChannelNorm2D constructor to verify it raises ValueError when input_channels is less than or equal to 1
